beats.text:
He's at the end of the bar with his back to the wall, which is where he always sits.

There's blood on his knuckles that isn't his.

text.Guns: Not his blood. Somebody paid for something tonight.
text.Bible: He sits like a man expecting to be called to answer for it.
text.Crystals: Somewhere under that, something in him is still flinching.

text.Guns:
Out the window, his bike sits with its chain back on.

He noticed. He noticed before you sat.
text.Bible:
By the door, the benefit flyer hangs straight now.

He's reading the name on it again.
text.Crystals:
Out on the sill, the ashtray sits empty.

He taps his pack and doesn't take one out.
